title: Best Digital Marketing Strategists (2026): A Plan That Fits You
description: How to hire a digital marketing strategist for a channel plan, budget split and growth roadmap: research, deliverables, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Digital marketing strategists create the plan behind your online marketing: which channels to use, which audiences to target, what messages to lead with and how to split your budget. A good strategy fits your business stage and resources. Strategies go wrong when they copy a template, recommend every channel at once or ignore your data and margins. This guide helps you get a strategy your team can actually execute.

faq.q: What is in a digital marketing strategy?
faq.a: Typically goals, audience profiles, positioning, channel priorities, budget allocation, content themes, a timeline and success measures.

faq.q: Do they also run the campaigns?
faq.a: Some do; others create the plan only. Clarify whether execution is included.

faq.q: How long should a strategy cover?
faq.a: Often three to twelve months, with regular reviews.
Sales, website analytics, past campaign results, customer feedback and budget.

faq.q: How do I know it is working?
faq.a: Agree on measurable goals and review progress monthly or quarterly.
